what: In a one-line list, a light bar behind the chosen row fills from the left over 20 seconds with no curve, and the row text flips to the background color only where the bar has passed (two text layers split with clip-path). When full it moves on to the next row, and clicking a row goes to that row and the bar refills from the start. The chosen row gains inner padding (.3em .4em) over .5s ease and the other rows fade to .75. When the row changes it emits fx:pick (detail.index) so the side panel (background video, photo) is swapped

options.every: Time spent on one line (sec), default 20 — the bar fills over the same length
options.auto: If “false,” it does not advance on its own (the bar stays filled)
options.--fx-pad: Inner padding of the selected row, default .3em .4em
options.[data-fx-part=row]: Row (required) — wraps the text cells inside in two layers
options.fx:pick: Event fired from the element when the line changes (bubbles) — detail.index · detail.row
options.el.fxPick(i): When picking a row from outside (swipe, keyboard, etc.)

from.where: index.html .hm-line (project list over full-screen video — bar 20s linear · click switches the background video)
